issue_context.title: [BUG]: HTML report incorrect total time
issue_context.body:
HTML report used to show the total execution time for all tests to finish, but now it seems like it calculates the combined total time it took for all tests to run instead.

Pictures will probably tell more.
![image](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/assets/110810683/17bb516a-5107-4d1a-8bb8-ac74d63cc5b1)
![image](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/assets/110810683/5a1af469-4606-4159-ab77-a98af471721b)
![image](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/assets/110810683/acaf7db1-c98e-4669-916e-697efef0498d)

Previous playwright version: 1.34.3
Current playwright version: 1.39.0

You can reproduce that by running a number of tests in parallel.

review_comments: It's a drive-by. If the expression evaluates to number 0, it is added as text on the page.
